{{Quote|Be careful, they're still making battle droids. Destroy their troop center to shut them down for good!|Qui-Gon Jinn to the Wookiees, referring to the troop center under GWC-04's command|audio=RipTroopCenter.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
'''GWC-04''' was an individual in the service of the [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|Droid Army]] of the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] during its [[Colonist/Legends|colonization]] effort on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Alaris Prime/Legends|Alaris Prime]]<ref name="GB" /> between [[39 BBY/Legends|39 BBY]] and [[36 BBY/Legends|36 BBY]].<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' places the [[Alaris Prime colonial war]] between [[39 BBY/Legends|39 BBY]] and [[36 BBY/Legends|36 BBY]].</ref> GWC-04 [[Commanding officer/Legends|commanded]] an [[Trade Federation outpost|outpost]] which contained a [[Barracks/Legends|troop center]] that produced [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]]s. Following the advice of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]], the outpost was [[Attack on the Trade Federation outpost|attacked]] for its strategic importance by [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Alaris Prime colonists|colonists]] led by [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], who wished to [[Alaris Prime colonial war|drive]] the Federation off Alaris Prime. Five of GWC-04's B1 battle [[Droid/Legends|droids]] failed to protect the outpost, and they were all destroyed along with the [[Trooper/Legends|troop]] center.<ref name="GB" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Warning: Your armies are being attacked by GWC-04!!!|Notification that appears when the player is attacked by GWC-04's droids|<ref name="GB" />}}
GWC-04 was first mentioned in the [[2001]] [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]'' as the commander of the Trade Federation units in the fifth level of the Wookiee tutorial campaign, "Exploration and Transport."<ref name="GB" />
